testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.migration.WorkflowRunPersistenceMigrationTests

testcase.name: steps belong to a run of the same tenant and go with their run()
the undo script guards in flight work and drops exactly the three V29 tables children first()
a workflow run must name a real project, and its workspace must match the tenant and the project()
C4 contract columns are part of V29 - action_runs mutating defaults to TRUE and is mandatory, the workflow lease is nullable and paired()
workflow run start is idempotent per scope and a TEST run never shares a key with a LIVE run()
status, mode, attempt and the RUNNING versus finished shape are enforced()
V29 is registered as the next migration and V28 is not renumbered()
status, compensation and the finished timestamp are constrained()
the undo script refuses while a run is in flight and changes nothing()
action_runs app_id accepts NULL and a NULL app is one key scope()
an application and its workspace come together or not at all()
the three tables exist and tenant_id is mandatory on all of them()
an action run cannot point at a workspace of another tenant or at a project of another workspace()
